subject: SOC2: personnel vetting delta report & ad-hoc sample request — Cloudwave trial
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@cloudwave.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Paul Nguyen <paul.nguyen@cloudwave.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Request: SOC2 personnel vetting delta samples for Cloudwave trial

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — Cloudwave's trial team needs a short packet to complete our SOC2 scoping. Specifically, the auditor is asking for: a) redacted background-check samples for hires in the last 12 months (at least 3 samples), b) training completion logs for those hires, and c) our standard onboarding/offboarding checklist with evidence of offboarding steps. They may request a brief attestation from Redwood HR confirming process adherence.

Can you provide a tranche we can share with the auditor by EOD Thursday? If redaction is sensitive, a secure Drive link and a DocuSign attestation will work.

Best,
Elena
Elena Torres
Security Engineer, Cloudwave AI
Attachment: request-checklist.pdf

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@cloudwave.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC2 personnel vetting delta samples for Cloudwave trial

Hi Elena —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick clarifications to make sure we prepare exactly what the auditor needs:

- When you say "background-check samples," do redacted identity markers (initials + year) suffice, or do you need hashed identifiers?
- For training logs: do they want completion timestamps + course IDs, or completion certificates?
- Confirm that a signed HR attestation (template attached) is acceptable in lieu of PDF copies of contracts.

We're happy to assemble: 3 redacted BG checks, training CSV export, and our onboarding/offboarding checklist with ticks and timestamps. We'll also include a high-level narrative of our prehire screening and termination deprovisioning steps.

I'll coordinate with People Ops — Vivek, can you pull redacted samples and the Q3 training export? Grace, please prepare the checklist export and a short process note (1 page).

Target: bundle to Elena by Thu 2026-12-03 EOD PT.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Director, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
Attachment: hr-attestation-template.docx

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 08:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC2 personnel vetting delta samples for Cloudwave trial

Aditya / Grace —

I've pulled three redacted background-check snapshots (candidates hired between 2026-02 and 2026-08). Redaction removes PII: SSN, birthdate, full address; records retain verification status, vendor check summary, and hire date. Also exporting Q3 training completions (CSV) that maps user id -> course_id -> completion_timestamp.

I'll place the files in a locked Drive folder and share a link to Elena. For audit purposes, I'm adding a short attestation (signed by HR manager) that these samples are representative of our standard verification process.

Files being prepared: personnel-vetting-sample-2026-redacted.pdf, training-rollout-log-2026-q3.csv, onboarding-offboarding-checklist-2026.xlsx. Expect link by Thu 09:00 PT.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of People Ops, Redwood Inference
Attachment: vetting-summary-notes.txt

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@cloudwave.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Paul Nguyen <paul.nguyen@cloudwave.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 07:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC2 personnel vetting delta samples for Cloudwave trial

Hi Vivek / Aditya —

That plan works. Hashing identifiers is not necessary as long as personal identifiers are fully redacted; initials + month-year is fine. For the training logs, the auditor prefers course IDs + completion timestamps (CSV is ideal). The signed HR attestation can be a DocuSign envelope.

If you can provide a brief (1-paragraph) explanation of how offboarding access removal is validated, that will speed review.

Thanks — looking forward to the Drive link.
Elena

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@cloudwave.ai>, Paul Nguyen <paul.nguyen@cloudwave.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC2 personnel vetting delta samples for Cloudwave trial

Elena / Paul —

Shared via secure Drive — link and short notes below. Files are redacted per your guidance. I also initiated a DocuSign envelope for the HR attestation; Vera (HR manager) is the signer.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cVettingsamples
Files included:
- personnel-vetting-sample-2026-redacted.pdf (3 samples, initials + month-year present)
- training-rollout-log-2026-q3.csv (user_id,course_id,completion_timestamp)
- onboarding-offboarding-checklist-2026.xlsx (checklist with timestamps & owner initials)
- vetting-process-note-2026.pdf (1 page summary of steps and vendors)

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/recipient/12345-Redwood-Attestation (attestation: "I certify that the samples are representative of Redwood Inference's standard personnel vetting and offboarding processes.")

Elena, let us know if the auditor needs the vendor report PDFs (we can provide with additional redaction) or a short video walkthrough of the offboarding verification.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Director, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
Attachments: attestation-template-signed-link.txt

From: Paul Nguyen <paul.nguyen@cloudwave.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena.torres@cloudwave.ai>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 16:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC2 personnel vetting delta samples for Cloudwave trial

Thanks Aditya — received the Drive link and DocuSign request. I routed to our auditor; quick question: can Redwood confirm retention windows for background-check records and the date-of-record retention policy? Auditor asked for retention policy language (preferably a pointer to your internal policy doc).

If you can drop that in the Drive folder (or paste the relevant paragraph), we'll be able to close this item.

Paul Nguyen
Procurement Manager, Cloudwave AI
Attachment: auditor-followup-note.txt
